subject: Huddle update and room change
text:
Hi,

Sorry for the scattered note, but the team huddle moved again. The original conference room was double-booked after the afternoon session ran over, so we have grabbed the second-floor training room near the printer. That space is smaller, which means the demo laptop is now more important than the printed handouts, so please bring your laptop and be ready to plug into the projector without too many fiddles.

The agenda is short: quick introductions, a five-minute update on the revised schedule, then we review the customer checklist. Because the room change came so late, please arrive ten minutes early so we can check the audio. If the projector fails, we will move to the shared screen on the desk, and I will email the slides just in case.

One complication: the refreshments vendor can no longer deliver by four o'clock, so lunch will be replaced with boxed sandwiches in the main hall after the meeting. If that timing affects anyone's next appointment, let me know now rather than later.

I know this is messy, but the important points are the new room, earlier start, and laptop instead of handouts. If anything still sounds unclear, reply here, and we will sort it out before the doors open.
